name: Artist's studio
desc: Making, failing and being seen; the room where the work is hanging on the walls.
tags: artist's studio, easel with a canvas, paint spattered floorboards, jars of brushes, palette crusted with paint, squeezed paint tubes, canvases stacked against the wall, tall north facing window, drop cloth, wooden stool, rags, plaster casts on a shelf
prose: an artist's studio with an easel standing in the light of a tall window, canvases leaning in stacks against the wall, jars of brushes and a paint-crusted palette on the bench and a spattered drop cloth underfoot
note: Mess is a noun problem: spatter on the boards, rags, squeezed tubes, stacked canvases. Messy studio on its own returns a tidy room with one easel in it. The tall window is load-bearing - it is what separates a studio from a spare bedroom. Whatever is painted ON the canvas gets invented and is usually garbled, so turn it away from camera unless the scene needs it, and never let it carry story.
